About this product

The VSOL GPON OLT SFP Module C++++ is a high-performance transceiver designed for use in Gigabit Passive Optical Network (GPON) Optical Line Terminals (OLTs). This Small Form-factor Pluggable (SFP) module has a C++++ power classification, providing a high optical power budget for extended reach and support for higher split ratios in your fibre network. It operates on a single-mode fibre (SMF) and is an essential component for service providers and network administrators deploying or expanding GPON infrastructure, ensuring reliable connectivity between the OLT and multiple Optical Network Units
